title: Tensura: Reincarnated Extra Data Models
description: Adds extra data models as support for Tensura,
body:
This adds extra Data Models to Hostile Neural Networks by offering support for Tensura Entities.

The datapack currently adds the following entities as Data Models:
- Akash
- Undine
- War Gnome
- Sylphide
- Ifrit
- Charybdis
- Elemental Colossus
- Orc Lord
- Orc Disaster
- Shizu
- Supermassive Slime
- Metal Slime
- Blade Tiger


_I plan on adding all the Tensura Entities gradually as Data Models.
Do leave feedback if the values need to change.
Do report any visual bugs regarding formatting and model sizes inside the Data Models **(currently the Supermassive Slime and Charybdis are not visible in Data Models due to their immense size)**._
